UBVELELA SIGNAGE AND PROMOTIONS is a branding company based in Olievenhoutbosch, Pretoria, serving businesses in Centurion and across South Africa. The company's core offering spans signage solutions, covering high-impact indoor and outdoor signage designed to increase a business's visibility, along with vehicle wrapping that turns company fleets into mobile advertising. It also provides branding and printing services aimed at maintaining a consistent corporate image, together with corporate gifting through promotional items intended to leave a lasting impression with clients.

The company describes itself as having decades of experience in the branding industry and positions itself as a partner that works closely with clients from initial consultation through to project completion, rather than offering a single standalone service. It maintains a portfolio of completed projects covering its various signage, vehicle branding and printing work for business clients in the Centurion and wider Pretoria area.

Uzuri Tech Solutions, trading as Uzuri Technologies, is a technology development and manufacturing company based in Copperleaf Golf and Country Estate, Centurion. The company focuses on designing and building technology solutions and devices intended to help businesses and society move into the future, with an emphasis on user-friendly, simplified and bespoke technology platforms rather than off-the-shelf products.

Its work covers both the hardware and software sides of a project, which the company says allows it to customise new-age technology platforms for a range of industries and to deliver what it describes as superior, effective and affordable solutions. Uzuri Tech Solutions positions itself as a developer of access platforms for various sectors, building technology that is tailored to each client's specific operational needs rather than a single standardised product.

Valhalla Pharmacy & Clinic operates from the Shoprite Centre at the corner of Kneen and Broadway Street in Valhalla, Centurion, as one of two stores nationwide under the Valhalla Health group. The pharmacy is open Monday to Friday from 08:30 to 18:00 and Saturday from 08:30 to 13:00.

Valhalla Health describes its pharmacists as a trusted, long-standing source of family healthcare advice for the local community, offering support across a range of health conditions and their treatment. Alongside dispensing, the in-store clinic provides basic health care services, with some branches offering wellness screenings, health screenings, disease management and virtual care consultations. The group positions its pharmacies as accessible, community-based health points that combine qualified pharmaceutical advice with practical, affordable care, giving Valhalla residents a nearby option for everyday health needs without having to travel further into Centurion for routine pharmacy and clinic services.

Vision Works Thatchfield is an optometry practice at Shop 9, Thatchfield Retail Centre in The Reeds, Thatchfield, Centurion, open Monday to Saturday from 9am to 6pm and Sundays and public holidays from 9am to 3pm. The practice offers full eye tests, with pricing starting at R299 for glasses wearers and R399 for contact lens wearers, and frames the exam as a routine check covering overall eye health rather than something to be anxious about.

Vision Works positions affordable, accessible eye care as a core part of its service, and the Thatchfield branch runs a number of ongoing offers including free eye exams for pensioners, a free-eye-test promotion for children, and a discount on designer sunglasses. The practice also dispenses a range of lens options, including Miyosmart myopia-control lenses, anti-reflective coatings and blue light filtering lenses, alongside its core eyewear and contact lens services for the Centurion area.

Vitalis Accounting is an accounting practice based in Sinoville, Pretoria, offering services that range from monthly bookkeeping through to the preparation of financial statements and taxation support. The practice places particular emphasis on management accounting, encouraging clients to review their monthly management accounts regularly rather than only at year end, and frames its taxation service as a way to help business owners stay legally compliant while reducing the stress around tax returns and tax debt.

Beyond its core accounting and taxation work, Vitalis Accounting offers value-added services aimed at helping businesses grow beyond what is strictly required to remain compliant. The firm describes itself as drawing on more than 30 years of experience across more than 40 different business sectors, built around three specialist service areas of management accounting, taxation and value-added services.

Vorsters Security in Doringkloof operates as part of the Vorsters Group, a multi-divisional company that also covers property management, distribution and labour services alongside security. The group describes its vision as creating and acquiring businesses that share a common goal of bringing value and improving the quality of life for South African citizens, for both clients and employees, while working within a multicultural country whose economy presents a diverse range of challenges and opportunities.

Vorsters Group positions itself as a partner that works directly with clients to identify where it can make a practical difference, rather than offering a single generic service. For the security division specifically, enquiries are handled through a call centre that operates Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, giving clients in the Centurion area a dedicated contact point for the group's security services.

VYFSTER ELEKTRIES is a family-run electrical contractor based in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, that has been operating since 1987. What began as a business wiring homes has grown into a broader electrical contracting operation covering commercial, residential and industrial installations across Centurion and the surrounding Gauteng area. The company's services include electrical maintenance, meeting electrical certification requirements, air conditioning installations and solar power installations, alongside its core wiring and installation work.

Vyfster Elektries describes itself as a trusted name in the industry that prioritises quality workmanship, carried out by technicians it describes as experienced and certified. The company frames itself as a family business in which the commitment to reliable service has been passed down over nearly four decades, rather than a franchise or branch of a larger national operation, giving it a long-standing, locally rooted presence in the Centurion electrical services market.

Waltloo Plastics is a plastic packaging manufacturer based in Waltloo, Pretoria, that was established in July 1996. The company manufactures polyethylene and plastic bags, tubing, sheeting and a variety of other flexible packaging products, using both virgin and recycled material.

Over nearly three decades of operation, it says it has built a reputation for supplying premium-quality products to customers in and around Gauteng, with its output used across a wide range of industries rather than a single sector. Waltloo Plastics describes its vision and mission as continuing to provide customers with top-quality products backed by reliable service and competitive pricing, while building long-lasting business relationships founded on professionalism, teamwork and integrity. The company operates from its Waltloo premises, supplying flexible plastic packaging to businesses across the greater Pretoria and Gauteng region.

Waltloo Plastics, located on Zasm Street in Waltloo, Pretoria, is a flexible packaging manufacturer that was established in July 1996. The business produces polyethylene and plastic bags, tubing, sheeting and other flexible packaging products from both virgin and recycled plastic, supplying customers throughout Gauteng.

Having operated for close to thirty years, the company says it has built a reputation for premium-quality products that are used across a broad range of industries. Waltloo Plastics states that its ongoing vision is to keep providing customers with reliable service, competitive prices and top-quality products, while developing long-term business relationships built on professionalism, teamwork and integrity. Operating from its Waltloo facility, the company continues to manufacture its range of flexible plastic packaging for businesses across the greater Pretoria and Gauteng area.

Water Pump Master is a pump supply and service company based in Florauna, Pretoria, operating Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm. The business specialises in delivering pumping solutions across the domestic, industrial, mining and agricultural sectors, covering everything from helping clients select new pumps through to the repair and maintenance of existing pump systems.

It describes its approach as customer-centric, working closely with each client to understand their specific requirements before recommending a solution, rather than offering a one-size-fits-all product. The company positions its team as experienced professionals focused on keeping pumping systems running efficiently, and while based in South Africa, it says its expertise and services extend to clients beyond the country's borders as well as within it.

WAXIT Hazeldean is a waxing and beauty salon at Hazeldean Square on Silver Lakes Road in Pretoria, operating Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm, Saturdays from 8am to 5pm, and Sundays and public holidays from 9am to 3pm. The salon opened in August 2024 as the 26th location in the WAXIT franchise network, offering waxing services for women, men and teenagers alongside brow tinting and lash treatments, with a published treatment price list available on request.

As with other WAXIT locations, the Hazeldean branch positions itself as a dedicated waxing destination rather than a general beauty salon, focusing its service menu specifically on hair removal and related brow and lash treatments. Its location within Hazeldean Square places it within the Silver Lakes area of Pretoria, giving it convenient reach to residents and office workers in that part of the city.

We Are Centurion is a local community platform focused on the Centurion area within the Tshwane Metropolitan Municipality, operating Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm. The platform combines three main elements: a business directory that lists trusted local businesses and service providers, an online television channel called WAC TV that produces content generated from within Centurion or on matters affecting its residents, and an events calendar covering things to do and places to go in the area.

Local businesses can be listed on the directory by contacting the platform directly, and residents can also have community events added to the calendar. We Are Centurion additionally publishes emergency and child-protection helpline contact details on its site as a resource for the community. The platform positions itself as a gateway to discovering what is happening locally, drawing together news, business listings and broadcast content under one community-focused banner.

Website Creators is a web design and hosting business based in Rietfontein, Pretoria, offering web hosting, web design and graphic design services to help clients build and manage their online presence. The company supports both onsite consultations and online appointments, allowing clients to collaborate on projects either in person or remotely, which it says keeps the process simple regardless of how a client prefers to work.

Its services focus on delivering responsive websites that work well across devices, combined with graphic design work intended to build and strengthen a client's branding. Website Creators positions itself as a long-term digital partner rather than a one-off vendor, supporting businesses from the initial launch of a website or brand identity through to ongoing maintenance as the business grows.

items.description:
Western National Insurance is a niche commercial insurer with an office in Montana Park, Pretoria, specialising in insurance solutions for the small to medium-sized commercial and business market in South Africa. The company was founded in Namibia in 2004, and its early success led to an expansion into the South African market in 2007. Western National focuses specifically on the commercial insurance space, offering a range of specialised products tailored to particular industries rather than generalist personal-lines cover, and says its flexibility and dedicated claims service are intended to help its network of insurance intermediaries provide clients with suitable cover.

Clients and brokers can access product brochures and submit claims through the company's broker portal and online claim forms. Having operated in South Africa since 2007, the company has built up close to two decades of experience in the local commercial insurance market from its Montana Park base.

Whisk Wine Bar is a restaurant and wine bar in Cornwall Hill Estate, Centurion, that describes itself as a laid-back venue offering food and beverages in a relaxed setting. The venue includes a large outdoor play area for children alongside its restaurant and bar areas, and it positions itself as a favourite wine bar for the Irene area, carrying one of the wider selections of spirits in the greater Pretoria region.

Its menu includes freshly prepared dishes, with several items described as family secret recipes, and the venue caters for events, functions and children's parties in addition to regular dining. Whisk Wine Bar also stocks a large range of craft and tap beer produced both locally and internationally, alongside a wine list that runs from popular varietals to rarer cultivars, and offers a selection of classic cocktails made with fresh ingredients for guests interested in mixology.

Wimpy Hallmark is a family restaurant located in Shop 17 of the Hallmark Building on Madiba Street (formerly Vermeulen Street) in Pretoria Central. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, including public holidays that fall on those days, and is closed on Saturdays and Sundays. The restaurant serves the chain's familiar menu of all-day breakfasts, burgers, toasted sandwiches and milkshakes, built around what it calls the Famous Wimpy Grill, and is positioned as a family-friendly stop for a hearty lunch or a quick coffee and light meal.

Customers can dine in, order takeaway, or arrange delivery. The branch's listed amenities include a braille menu, counter service and debit card payment, along with breakfast, brunch, coffee, comfort food and dessert options, reflecting its role as a casual, all-day dining option for office workers and shoppers in the Pretoria Central area.

items.description:
Yellow Fat Biltong is a biltong and braai meat shop located in Magalieskruin Centre on Braam Pretorius Street, Magalieskruin, Pretoria. The shop specialises in biltong that customers can have made to their preferred dryness and fat content, alongside a range of meat cuts suited to weekend braais, including Wagyu and other grades, as well as dried sausage.

Shopping is done in-store, with card payments accepted, and the premises include a wheelchair accessible entrance and parking. Yellow Fat Biltong positions itself around a focused product range rather than operating as a general butchery, concentrating specifically on biltong and braai meat with an emphasis on letting customers tailor the texture and fat content of their order. Its location within Magalieskruin Centre places it within easy reach of residents and shoppers in the surrounding Magalieskruin area of Pretoria.

Yoliswa Ventures, based in Lydiana, Pretoria, is the registered company group operating the Borderless Self digital platform. According to the platform's legal information, Borderless Self is owned and operated by Yoliswa Ventures, with the brand, website, applications and related services forming part of the Yoliswa Ventures group of companies, which operates through a number of registered legal entities that support the platform's development, operation, compliance, partnerships and commercial activities.

Borderless Self itself is built around tools aimed at people researching international relocation, including a relocation decision tool, country comparison features, country guides and a glossary of relevant terms, along with content sections covering data, stories and historical and future-looking perspectives on migration. Yoliswa Ventures' role is to own and commercially support this platform from its Lydiana base rather than to operate a storefront or client-facing office there.

Zambezi (Montana) Midas is a Midas-branded motor spares outlet trading from Montana Piazza in Pretoria. The store supplies car parts, motor spares, tools and accessories to motorists, with customers able to confirm part availability by sharing their vehicle's VIN or make, model and year together with the part they need. Its range is organised into categories covering service parts and maintenance essentials, engine parts, filters and fluids, hand and power tools, auto electrical components and wiring, trailer parts and accessories, car care and cleaning products, and general vehicle accessories.

The branch also stocks oils, lubricants and fluids matched to specific vehicle requirements. Operating as part of the Midas motor spares network, the Montana Piazza store serves as a local parts and accessories supplier for motorists in the Montana area of Pretoria.

ZATER is a custom-branded water bottling company based at the Co.Space Entrepreneur Village in Willow Park Manor, Pretoria. The business produces custom-labelled still and sparkling water for other companies, designing labels in-house once a client supplies a logo, and promises delivery from approval to a finished, branded product within three to four working days. Its water goes through a five-stage purification process and is supplied in a choice of bottle formats, including cylindrical bottles from 330ml up to 1.5 litres, smaller teardrop-style bottles, and large five and ten litre containers for bulk use.

ZATER also operates a bottle collection service, retrieving used bottles from client premises and arranging for them to be recycled, which it positions as part of keeping its clients' branding environmentally responsible. The company handles the design, water production and delivery logistics directly, allowing client businesses to use branded water as a promotional item without managing those processes themselves.

Zela-Tech Zambesi CC is an electronic security equipment supplier based in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, that was registered as a close corporation in 1999. The company initially supplied electronic security equipment to both trade and retail or DIY customers, and has since built partnerships with established security brands including Centurion, Kwebeams, Sentry, IDS, Sherlotronics and Cellsecure. Zela-Tech Zambesi specialises in wireless and outdoor security systems, stocking products such as gate motors, rechargeable batteries, wireless range extenders with a range of up to a kilometre, and indoor wireless anti-mask infrared sensors, alongside remotes, receivers and other gate automation components.

More recently, the company has expanded into online commerce to reach customers beyond its traditional trade and retail base. With close to three decades in the electronic security industry, Zela-Tech Zambesi positions itself around the Kwebeams product range and related wireless security and gate automation equipment for both residential and commercial use.

Zero Plus Printers is a print company based in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, offering a full range of printing services from design through to delivery. Its pre-press team assists with design work ahead of printing, while its litho printing service handles high-volume, high-quality print runs and its digital printing covers smaller to medium volumes up to A3 size. The company also offers wide-format printing and cutting for rigid or flexible media, along with a range of finishing options to complete a print job.

Beyond standard printing, Zero Plus Printers provides embroidery for custom branding and a range of promotional gifts and products. Finished orders are dispatched directly from its Pretoria premises, with the company stating it can deliver completed print work to anywhere in South Africa, extending its reach well beyond the immediate Pretoria area.

0861Nutsman is a handyman and renovation company that, according to its Centurion-focused site, operates in Centurion, Garsfontein, George and Mossel Bay. The business positions itself as a renovation and maintenance specialist for home improvement and painting work, and has more recently added project management services to oversee jobs from start to finish.

It backs its painting work specifically with a guarantee of up to seven years, longer than the standard one-year guarantee it offers across its other workmanship, saying this reflects the amount of preparation it puts into a surface before painting rather than simply disguising existing problems. Its repair work covers issues such as damaged wall plaster, minor and structural cracks, and water-damaged walls. The company distinguishes between macro projects, which are larger jobs requiring several trades working together, and micro projects, where a single tradesman completes a number of smaller tasks on one site, covering both ends of typical home maintenance needs.

1Worx (Pty) Ltd is a technology company based in Southdowns, Centurion, that develops Industrial Internet of Things and augmented reality solutions for the mining sector. The company was founded in 2016, initially reselling a leading third-party IIoT development platform, and gained most of its early traction within the mining industry. Having identified a gap for off-the-shelf solutions purpose-built for mining operations, the company decided in July 2021 to begin developing its own products, which it now brings to market as MineWorx and MineVu.

MineWorx uses IIoT technology to improve the visibility, efficiency and effectiveness of mining operations, giving operators clearer real-time insight into production, assets and safety in order to help reduce downtime. The company describes its guiding purpose as making the benefits of IIoT and augmented reality accessible to all mines and all mine employees, across all areas of a mining operation, rather than limiting its technology to large operators alone.

3 Step Teambuilding is a corporate team-building and training company based in Zwartkop, Centurion, with more than ten years of experience running team experiences across South Africa. The company customises its activities to suit each team's goals, catering for groups ranging from as few as six participants up to more than 600, and offers professional facilitation not only in Pretoria but also in Johannesburg and Durban and beyond. Its approach is built around what it describes as proven activities intended to build stronger communication and collaboration within a team, rather than offering entertainment alone, with the stated aim of creating lasting value for the organisations it works with.

Photography of each event is included as part of the service at no additional cost. The company operates Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, coordinating corporate bookings for teams across the country from its Centurion base.

3Pin is a commercial hygiene and facilities supplier based in Hennopspark, Centurion, covering washroom equipment and consumables, cleaning equipment and consumables, waste and smoking management, and ice makers and refrigeration units for businesses and institutions. Its washroom range includes hand dryers, toilet paper and paper towel dispensers, hand soap and sanitiser dispensers, air freshener systems, sanitary towel hygiene units and general washroom hardware such as baby changing stations.

On the cleaning side, the company supplies brushware, cleaning cloths, floor cleaning equipment and related consumables, alongside dedicated toilet and urinal sanitation products such as toilet seat cleaners and urinal blocks. By combining washroom, cleaning, waste management and refrigeration equipment under one supplier, 3Pin positions itself as a single point of contact for the day-to-day hygiene and facilities consumables that offices, retail premises and other institutions in the Centurion area need to keep operating.

3t Business Fusion is a tourism and conservation consulting company based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, that works with clients on sustainable tourism development, biodiversity management and the rejuvenation of conservation sites. The company's stated areas of focus include tourism quality management, including assistance with star grading, biodiversity management, business commercialisation of tourism assets, and transforming underused conservation sites into functioning, revenue-generating operations. It also offers fundraising management specifically for conservation projects, alongside broader services in research and development, policy development and technology support for the sector.

On the commercial side, 3t Business Fusion provides marketing strategy, sales strategy and revenue management services aimed at helping tourism and conservation operators grow their income, as well as change management support and end-to-end project management for organisations implementing new systems or processes. The company draws on its team's operational and strategic experience in the tourism industry to advise on both the conservation and business sides of running a tourism site.

4PL Group is a logistics and supply chain company based in Irene Farm Villages, Centurion, operating alongside a number of subsidiary businesses including 4PL Cape, 4PL Fleet, 4PL Africa, 4PL International Clearing & Forwarding, Transmart and Baobab Crossborder Services. Together, the group describes itself as a leading provider of integrated supply chain and transport services across Southern Africa and internationally.

Its service range covers bulk transport, road transport and warehousing, clearing and forwarding, and cross-border and express freight services, supported by dedicated transport and warehousing operations elsewhere in Africa. The group says it offers both asset-based and non-asset-based logistics solutions, combining its own transport fleet and warehousing with partnerships that extend its reach where needed. Its stated core values centre on service, intelligent problem-solving, professionalism and accessibility, which it says guide how its various subsidiaries work together to give clients a single, coordinated supply chain partner.

62 Waters is a bottled water producer and distributor based in Rooihuiskraal North, Centurion, that both manufactures and bottles its own drinking water. The company supplies small, medium and large businesses with bottled water and water dispensers, available either for purchase or on a rental basis, aimed mainly at meeting office hydration needs. Its team draws on more than 70 years of combined experience in the manufacturing and distribution of food and beverages, and the company says this experience has helped it set the pace within the bottled water industry.

While based in Centurion, 62 Waters' distribution centres extend its delivery reach across Gauteng and into the Western Cape, with water typically delivered on a bi-weekly schedule, though an alternative schedule can be arranged directly with the company's head office. Alongside bottled water and dispensers, 62 Waters also supplies coffee machines and runs its own Factory Shop from its Centurion base, offering dispenser sanitisation and repair services.

items.description:
Acheron Systems is a software development company based in Wingate Park, Pretoria, that specialises in cloud-native development and microservices architecture. The company designs and builds tailor-made software for businesses, with a particular focus on helping clients replace older, monolithic systems with modular, scalable platforms that can grow alongside their needs.

Its work spans three main sectors: finance, where it builds secure, high-availability systems such as transaction processing, reporting and reconciliation tools designed to meet strict regulatory standards; security, where it develops software integrating access control, monitoring and incident management into a single platform; and service delivery, where it builds custom software to help organisations track, manage and optimise field operations and customer-facing processes. Technically, Acheron Systems builds containerised applications for deployment on major cloud platforms designed to scale automatically, decomposes complex systems into independent microservices that individual teams can own and evolve, and develops bespoke applications ranging from API backends to web and mobile front-ends.

This Ackermans store trades from Sport Park Centre on Napier Road in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, as one of the retailer's branches in the clothes, shoes and accessories category. According to its store listing, the branch is open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 and Saturday from 08:30 to 17:00, and is closed on Sundays.

As with other Ackermans branches, the Lyttelton Manor store sells clothing, footwear and accessories for the whole family at the chain's typical value pricing. Its location on Napier Road places it close to other retailers and services in the same stretch of Centurion, giving shoppers in Lyttelton Manor and the surrounding suburbs a nearby branch of the chain without needing to travel into Centurion's larger shopping centres for everyday clothing and accessory purchases.

This Ackermans store trades from Jubilee Mall at the corner of Jubilee and Harry Gwala Roads in Hammanskraal, as part of the national Ackermans clothing, footwear and accessories chain. Its store listing shows the branch open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 and Saturday from 08:30 to 17:00, with the store closed on Sundays.

The Hammanskraal branch sits within Jubilee Mall alongside a number of other retailers, including a nearby hardware store and a supermarket, giving shoppers in the area a single stop for clothing and accessories without having to travel further afield. As with other Ackermans stores, the Hammanskraal branch focuses on affordable clothing, footwear and accessories for the whole family, serving the Hammanskraal community from within its established retail centre.

Ahlaams Gourmet Grills is a restaurant in Centurion, located on Helena Street in the Erasmia area, known for its steaks and burgers. According to its listing, visitors to the restaurant have commented on the attentive service and prompt turnaround from the kitchen, as well as the restaurant's atmosphere.

The restaurant is open daily, including extended hours over the weekend, and offers delivery, takeaway and wheelchair accessible facilities for guests who prefer not to dine on site. Beyond everyday dining, the venue caters for a range of occasions, with outdoor seating and a kids' play area making it an option for family visits, while its facilities are also used for occasions such as birthday parties and weddings. Alongside its grilled dishes, fish features on the menu, giving diners in the Centurion area a casual, family-oriented restaurant for both quick meals and larger group occasions.
